content: Lufwa lwa Yowani Mubotiki
Muna tangwa meni dina, wáyuka
Eloti, wuna wákala mosi wa bakyamvu baya, kuzonzila Yesu;
amana wázimbula kwena basadi bandi: «Yandu-yandu kenina Yowani Mubotiki: yandi wufutumuki ku bafwa! Amana kikuma kya bwabuna kenina yi hamu dya kusadila biphadi.»
Mukuma Eloti wámukwatisa Yowani, wámukasisa mu miyololu amana wámukotisa mu boloku, kikuma kya Elodyadi mukhetu wa Fidiphu phangi wandi.
Kikuma Yowani kakala muzimbwala: «Weku yi muswa wa kumubonga hanga mukhetu waku.»
Amana bwosu kázola kumuhondisa, wáyuka bweya bwa mulumba-lumba wa batu, mukuma bakala mumona Yowani hanga mbikudi.
Kinga, kuna mukinzi wa lubutuku lwa Eloti, mwana wa mukhetu wa Elodyadi wákina hana kati dya batu amana wámusephidisa lawu Eloti;
Hanga mu kudya ndefi, wábonga lukanu lwa kumuheka kina kámulomba.
Amana mwana wa mukhetu bámukoma kwena ngudi wandi, wumuzimbudi: «Pheka hakaka, mutwa wa Yowani Mubotiki, ha dilonga!»
Amana kyamvu mu kiwayi, kikuma kya ndefi yina kadya ku thwala ya babana kátedisa, wáhana muswa bamuhekawa.
Amana wátuma kubukuna mutwa wa Yowani muna boloku.
Amana bánata mutwa wandi hana dilonga, báhanawa kwena mwana wa mukhetu, amana yandi wánatawa kwena ngudi wandi.
Amana balonguki bandi bisa bonga mvumbi yandi, bámuzika; buna bisa, básamunabwa kwena Yesu.
Yesu wudisi mafunda matanu ma batu
Buna káyuka musamu wuna, Yesu wákatuka hana, wábonga mudimba wumosi ndangu kendila mu nganga ku phungamu; amana buna báyuka milumba-lumba mya batu, bámulanda mu malu, tuka ku mbanza.
Amana buna kálubuka mu mudimba, wámona mulumba-lumba mosi wa batu, wáyuka kyadi kikuma kya bawu amana wábuka bambefu ba bawu.
Buna mábwa masikidika, balonguki bábwesuka kwena yandi, bazimbudini: «Homa thwenina ha tseki, tangwa phi diluti. Sula milumba-lumba mya batu, ndangu benda mu mahata, badisumbila bima bya kudya.»
Kaasi Yesu wubazimbwadi: «Beku yi mupfunu wa kukwenda; bahekenu benu-benu bima bya kudya.»
Kaasi bamuzimbwadini: «Thwenina lwesi haha yi mapha matanu yi batsema bodi!»
Amana yandi wuzimbudi: «Ndatinenubya kwaku.»

Amana wuhani muswa kwena milumba-lumba mya batu bazakala muna mwangu, buna kátambula mapha mana matanu yi batsema bodi, wusekudi mesu ku zilu, wuvutudi matondu kwena Nzambi, wubukuni mapha amana wuhanibya kwena balonguki; bawu bákabisibya kwena milumba-lumba mya batu.
Boosu bádya amana báyukuta. Bánata bitunga kumi yi byodi bya kabasi yi bitini bina byálutuka
Batu bana badya, bákala kitesu kya mafunda matanu ma bayakala, konda kutanga bakhetu yi bana.
Yesu wukangadi ha thandu ya yanga
Amana buna bámanisa batu, wásenda kwena balonguki mu kukota mu masuwa, bámutekila kuna sambwa dina dikwawu, kithama kina kasudila yandi meni milumba-lumba mya batu.
Kunima dya kusula milumba-lumba mya batu, wátombuka ku mongu kikuma kya kulombila ku phungamu; amana ha kwáyila kuma, yandi buhika kákala kwakuna.
Amana masuwa mekina kedi kyana kya lawu yi mafu, makaka makala dibunda kuna masuwa mukuma pfunzi yakala tadisa kuna bakala kwisila bawu.
Amana muna khoku wa theti, Yesu wísa mu kukangala hana thandu ya yanga, kuna bákala bawu.
Amana balonguki buna bámumona yandi ni ha thandu ya yanga kabati kangala, bweya bwábakwata lawu amana bazimbudi: «Kiphedikisa kina!» Bakalunga kikuma kya bweya.
Muna mbala mosi, Yesu wábazimbwala: «Kalenu yi kikesa! Meni yandu, luyukaku bweya!»
Amana Phetelu wumuvutwadi: «Pfumu, yukani ngeyi wuna; pheka muswa ndangu meni phi yisa kwena ngeyi hana mukanda wa mamba.»
Amana yandi wuvutudi: «Awisa!» Buna kátuluka mu mudimba, Phetelu wákangala hana mukanda wa mamba mu kukwenda kwena Yesu.
Kaasi mu kumona muphephi wuna wa ngolu, wáyuka bweya. Amana buna káyandika kutika, wákalunga: «Pfumu, phulula!»
Amana muna mbala mosi, Yesu wáyuna koku, wámusimba wumuzimbwadi: «Mutu wa lukwikilu lwa khunda! Kikuma kya biki wenina yi keti-keti?»
Amana bákota mu mudimba, pfunzi yálembama.
Amana bana bákala mu mudimba báfukama kuna thwala yandi, bázimbula phi: «Kyedika ngeyi wenina Mwana wa Nzambi!»
Yesu wubeludi bambefu ku mulambu wa Ngenezaleti
Buna básabuka, bátula ku mulambu wa Ngenezaleti
Amana batu ba mulambu meni wuna bámubakula, báyadingisa phi musamu muna mulambu wuna wosu, amana bámunatina bambefu boosu.
Amana bámubokwadila ni basimba lwesi keti nzenzi ya muledi wandi; amana boosu bana básimbawa, bábeluka.

footnotes.text: Bwabu bubati songila Eloti Atiphasi, mosi wa bana ba kyamvu wa mbuta (2:1).
Longu meni luna lwakalaku mu ndonga ku thwala mitsiku mya Bayuta (Lev 20:21), mukuma Eloti wakwela Elodyadi kinga phangi wandi Fidiphu hana mu luzingu kakala.

Kuzenga mutwa kwakala phila mosi bakala sadila, muna tangwa dina, kwena bisi Loma mu kuhonda mutu. Elodyadi kakala zola mutwa hana dilonga ndangu kalenga mona ni Yowani bamuhonda. Hanga mutwa walosama.
